demand.title: Project 3in1: Innovative Approaches to Discovering Consumer Needs. An In-Depth Detergent Market Overview and Trend Analysis. (Call for EU University students ONLY)
demand.description: The project's aim is to uncover hidden consumer needs (both current and future) and pain points in the world of laundry detergent consumption. The focus is on identifying and understanding consumers and all of their specifics across strategically selected European countries. Submission Requirements (University Students application ONLY), 3,000 Euros funding support to student teams selected. This is an exclusive call for university students within the European Union to participate in an exciting opportunity to co-create an innovative solution in collaboration with a leading company under the INDUSAC EU-funded project. Supported by Innoget, this initiative aims to foster collaboration between academia and industry, empowering students to contribute their knowledge and creativity to tackle real-world challenges.

candidate.title: [DRY-RUN] Candidate Invention for C08L
candidate.description: Cold-water active surfactant system with biocompatible microencapsulation.
candidate.claimed_novelty: Activation temperature window under 20C with zero phosphorus release.
candidate.novelty_claim: Activation temperature window under 20C with zero phosphorus release.

verdict.rationale: Differentiates from cited domestic prior art ES-2789123-B2 in room temperature kinetic activation.
